effect: Removes the nationalisation/privatisation price cliff at zero profit: sector value = max(operating profit x multiple, 0.35 x productive capital) instead of profit x multiple when profit is positive and 0.35 x capital otherwise. A sector earning barely above zero is now worth at least its asset floor, so a demand dip no longer lets the state buy it for a fraction of its assets; sectors whose earnings value exceeds 35% of their capital are priced as before. The floor also binds for profitable sectors with low earnings relative to capital: about 14% of country-sector aggregates at day 31 (all profitable), priced up to about 30% higher, total value about +1.2% (critic's reconstruction). Applies to player and AI transfers, buy and sell. Net-debt adjustment and profit smoothing are deferred (see QUESTIONS.md). No day-0 or saved-state effect. (Minified names in this text are those of build 26296134; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
